channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dante Exum | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dante Exum from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Dante Exum
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Dante Exum:

“The way you see him playing, I think everyone here in Utah envisioned that this was going to take place but just sometimes it takes time.”

Jason Kidd on Dante Exum, Jan 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Dante Exum
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on Dante Exum’s trade:

“It’s fun to see him have a new start. I think maybe that was a good thing for him. It was hard to see him leave, but at the same time, (good) for him to show what he can do.”

Rudy Gobert on Dante Exum, Mar 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Dante Exum
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Dante Exum-Jordan Clarkson trade:

“You have to give something up to get something. Dante is someone we thought a lot of as a player and as a person. But at the same time, we’re excited about Jordan.”

Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Dante Exum, Dec 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Dante Exum
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell, on Dante Exum’s trade:

“That’s my guy, man. It’s moments like this you always remember that it is a business. He’s a guy that’s been such an incredible spirit. ... I loved him as a teammate. A great teammate, a great dude.”

Donovan Mitchell on Dante Exum, Dec 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Dante Exum
item.description:
Rudy Gobert, on Dante Exum:

“Dante is my guy. It’s been 6 years together. He’s a great guy, so it’s sad to see him leave. I hope he’s gonna have a great opportunity there and he’s gonna be able to show what he can do.”

Rudy Gobert on Dante Exum, Dec 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dante Exum
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on Dante Exum's injury:

“You just feel awful, for him first and foremost.… My discussion with him has been similar to other times he's had those setbacks, and figure out a way to use it, and we'll see what happens going forward. … But it's a blow for the kid.”

Quin Snyder on Dante Exum, Mar 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on James Harden, Dante Exum
item.description:
Mark Berman:Donovan Mitchell on Dante Exum's defense on James Harden:

“What he's done on the defensive end against probably MVP this year is impressive... How he disrupts him. How he gets him to not really shoot those threes.”

Donovan Mitchell on James Harden, Dante Exum, May 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dante Exum
item.description:
Jazz coach Quin Snyder on Danté Exum’s return:

“Over this next week, they're going to continue to evaluate where he is, but he's put himself in a position where there's a very real chance that he's going to be able to come back this year and we're hoping sooner than later.”

Quin Snyder on Dante Exum, Mar 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Dante Exum
item.description:
Kyle Goon:Joe Ingles on Dante Exum:

“It's good to have him around. We're going to keep supporting him until he knows what he's going to do.”

Joe Ingles on Dante Exum, Oct 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dante Exum
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Quin Snyder on Dante Exum's knee:

“He's out today, and I'm not sure what the situation will be tomorrow.”

Quin Snyder on Dante Exum, Dec 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Trey Burke on Raul Neto, Dante Exum
item.description:

“Nothing is worth anything without some adversity. Second, he knew and so did the Jazz management and coaching staff that he was a better player than Dante Exum and Raul Neto. Numbers never lie.”

Trey Burke on Raul Neto, Dante Exum, Oct 5, 2016. Source: Fox Sports.

item.title: Roy Rana on Dante Exum
item.description:
Roy Rana, who coached Exum and Andrew Wiggins to a victory for the World Team in the 2012 Nike Hoop Summit, said Exum will be an impact NBA player.

“I think whoever drafts Exum is going to be very, very pleased,”

Roy Rana on Dante Exum, Jun 22, 2014. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Dante Exum
item.description:
David 'Dubi' Pick:Joe Ingles on Australian NT roommate and NBA prospect Dante Exum:

“He's going No. 3 or 4. I have my sources. Let's see.”

Joe Ingles on Dante Exum, Jun 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @IAmDPick.
